verdict.rationale: Synctera documents an ACH guide that describes ACH as covering 'a variety of payment use cases', and it references issuing ACH debits after external-account verification. It also has a general Webhook API for subscribing to platform events. That establishes basic API-driven ACH origination, but none of the unhappy-path modeling is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit ACH credit and debit origination docs, same-day ACH windows, returns/NOCs/reversals as first-class objects, ACH-specific webhook events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
